# Vejle: Børne- Og Ungdomspsykiatrisk Ambulatorium

Vejle: Børne- Og Ungdomspsykiatrisk Ambulatorium is a child and adolescent psychiatric outpatient department located in [[region-syddanmark|Region Syddanmark]], Denmark [^src1] [^src2] [^src15]. It is one of the clinical units that reports its ADHD assessment and treatment outcomes to the [[adhd-databasen|ADHD-databasen]], the Danish national quality-monitoring register for ADHD care [^src8], and it appears repeatedly across two consecutive annual reports (covering the periods 2022/23–2023/24 and 2023/24–2024/25) as one of the departments tracked for compliance with the register's quality indicators.

The department's standout result is its performance on Indicator 2a, which measures whether children aged 0–5 receive a clinical environmental observation during ADHD assessment. In the report covering 2022/23, Vejle achieved 100% compliance (77–100% confidence interval) across all 14 assessment courses reviewed [^src1], and it was named alongside the child and adolescent outpatient clinics in Aabenraa, Odense and the BUA Psychiatric Clinic for Young Children in Midtjylland as meeting the indicator's standard [^src12]. This strong performance was sustained into the following reporting year, with the 2024 report showing 18 out of 18 courses (100%, 81–100% CI) meeting the standard — placing Vejle, together with the Aabenraa clinic, among the departments that hit the development goal for Indicator 2a in both the 2023/24 and 2022/23 periods [^src5].

Vejle's record on other quality indicators is markedly weaker, illustrating the broader pattern described in the ADHD-databasen reports of strong performance on some measures and severe shortfalls on others. On Indicator 3 (diagnostic conferences held within 120 days of assessment start), the department reported 0 out of 406 courses meeting the standard (0%) in the 2023 report [^src2], and in the 2024 report its result of 8% (28 of 338 courses, CI 6–12%) placed it at the low end of a range that varied from 66% down to 8% among departments with more than three courses [^src13]. On Indicator 4 (coordinating network meetings), Vejle achieved 13% compliance (34 of 266 courses, CI 9–17%) in one reporting cycle [^src3] and 7% (19 of 266, CI 4–11%) in another cycle covered by the same report [^src4]. On Indicator 2b (diagnostic interview or environmental observation for older children), the department reported 58% compliance (229 of 392 courses) [^src12], while the 2024 report separately recorded a 31% figure (98 of 320 courses, CI 26–36%) alongside the 100% Indicator 2a result on the same page [^src5]. Additional metrics for Vejle appear in later chapters of the 2024 report covering further indicators in the assessment and treatment pathway, including results of 6% (18 of 281 courses) [^src6], 12% (35 of 281 courses, CI 9–17%) [^src7], 74% (208 of 281 courses, CI 68–79%) [^src8], 9% (CI 0–41%) [^src9], 73% (8 of 11 courses, CI 39–94%) [^src10], and a raw count of 6 [^src11].

On somatic examination, the 2023 report recorded that Vejle carried out somatic work-ups in 209 of 406 assessment courses, a rate of 51% [^src15]. The report also links a regional decline in Region Syddanmark's performance to staffing pressures at two specific departments: it attributes the fall to "et stort fald på afdelinger i Esbjerg og Vejle formentlig betinget af færre lægekræfter her," i.e., a large drop at the Esbjerg and Vejle departments likely caused by a shortage of physicians [^src1], tying Vejle's performance directly to that of the [[esbjerg-boerne-ungdomspsykiatrisk-ambulatorium|Esbjerg Børne- Og Ungdomspsykiatrisk Ambulatorium]] within the same region.

## Claims

**Causal analysis**
- Faldet i Region Syddanmark skyldes et stort fald på afdelinger i Esbjerg og Vejle formentlig betinget af færre lægekræfter her (involving [[region-syddanmark|Region Syddanmark]], [[esbjerg-boerne-ungdomspsykiatrisk-ambulatorium|Esbjerg Børne- Og Ungdomspsykiatrisk Ambulatorium]], Vejle: Børne- Og Ungdomspsykiatrisk Ambulatorium) [^src1]

**Performance metric**
- Vejle: Børne- Og Ungdomspsykiatrisk Ambulatorium opfylder standarden for klinisk miljøobservation med 100 % compliance blandt 14 forløb [^src1]

**Performance**
- Vejle: Børne- Og Ungdomspsykiatrisk Ambulatorium opnåede 0 % opfyldelse af Indikator 3 blandt 406 udredningsforløb [^src3]
- PSY Børne- Og Ungdomspsykiatrisk Ambulatorium (Vejle) og PSY Børne- og Ungdomspsykiatrisk Ambulatorium (Aabenraa) begge nåede udviklingsmålet med 100 % opfyldelse af indikator 2a, hvilket også var tilfældet både i 2023/24 og 2022/23 [^src1]
- Børne- og Ungdomsambulatorierne i Vejle har 58 % andel på indikator 2b (229 / 392) [^src1]
- Blandt afdelinger med mere end tre forløb varierer resultaterne på Indikator 3 fra 66 % ned til 8 % på PSY Børne- Og Ungdomspsykiatrisk Ambulatorium (Vejle)[^src1]

**Facility performance**
- Vejle havde 13 % opfyldelse af indikator 4 (95% CI: 9-17) med 34 forløb ud af 266 [^src1]
